title: P1_START/P2_START/ARGMAX_START have no loads; Pool/Argmax use generic START
evidence: top.net: P1_START only U1008.17, P2_START only U1008.15, ARGMAX_START only U1008.12; START net includes U5036.1/U5037.5/U6036.4/U6037.5; build_pool.py:501/514 and build_argmax.py:328/339 connect START.
fix: OR P1_START/P2_START into Pool start; use ARGMAX_START for Argmax; regenerate.

title: Engine address and chip-select nets do not reach S04
evidence: top.net: C1_ADDR0..15, C2_ADDR0..15, FC_ADDR0..15 are single-node; Cx_MEM_nCE_* are single-node; S04 ADDR/MEM_SEL only from S10 U10093/U10096.
fix: Add bus owner/arbiter that muxes active engine ADDR/bank selects onto S04 ADDR/MEM_SEL and gates S04 chip selects.

title: S02 MEM_DATA/ACK/DONE/BUSY and engine memory handshake are not closed
evidence: top.net: MEM_DATA0..7 only U2010; MEM_ACK/DONE/BUSY only U2005+TP; C1_MEM_ACK only U7136/U7137/U7145; C1_MEM_DONE/BUSY/nOE/nWE single-node.
fix: Connect S02 data/ACK/DONE/BUSY to the bus owner and active engine; add request/owner mux.

title: DONE is driven by two enabled 74HCT541 outputs
evidence: top.net DONE nodes U1009.17 and U5039.17; both 74HCT541 G1/G2 tied GND in build_supervisor.py:158-172 and build_pool.py:550-558.
fix: Rename Pool output to POOL_DONE; keep only S01 DONE on the global net.

title: Requant parameter buses are unexpanded; BIAS/M/SHIFT/ZP/N_MACS floating
evidence: top.audit.json unexpanded_bus_nets 27; C1_B_DATA[31:0], C1_M[31:0], C1_SHIFT[5:0], C1_ZP_X/W/OUT[15:0], C1_N_MACS[15:0] only U7123 pins 9-15; C1_ACC has bit members and is connected.
fix: Wire qparam/BIAS/M/SHIFT/ZP/N_MACS from memory/registers, or expand Requant into a real sheet with defined inputs.

title: S02_MEM_IF WAIT/ACK/DONE/BUSY and chip-select outputs are floating
evidence: top.audit.json: C1_WAIT_READ/WRITE buses unexpanded; C1_MEM_nOE/nWE/DONE/BUSY single-node; C1_MEM_nCE_* single-node; C1_MEM_ACK only local microcode ROM address pins.
fix: Remove/replace the placeholder S02_MEM_IF blocks with a shared S02 client/bus owner; route handshake.

title: 42 top ERC errors are Pool/Argmax data inputs, not external interfaces
evidence: output/erc/CNN_74xx_System.rpt: 32x U6004-U6007 D0-D7 (S06), 8x U5012/U5013 A0-A3 (S05), U5005.P2, U9005.S.
fix: Wire Pool input data and Argmax SCORE_DATA; reclassify ERC in docs.

title: 12 LUT_Mult_Unit symbols vs 4 shared LUT lanes / 8x27C512
evidence: BOM: 12 LUT_Mult_Unit block symbols; S04: 8x27C512 in 4 pairs; S07/S08/S09 each show 4 logical LUT blocks; engine 2x27C512 are local microcode.
fix: Decide shared 4-lane bank vs 12 independent units; expand accordingly; update BOM/memory map.

title: Requant is an architectural macro, not a gate-level implementation
evidence: Requant_Block symbol only; BOM 3 blocks; no S_Requant sheet; docs REPORT_Conv_FC.md:138-152 describes internal math but no logic.
fix: Build S_Requant with serial 32x16 multiplier, 64-bit product, shift/round/saturate, zero-point correction; simulate.

title: 10-100 Hz clock breaks default wait/timeout/pulse assumptions
evidence: S02 WAIT_READ=3/WAIT_WRITE=2; S01 24-bit timeout; 8 MHz X1; 10 Hz gives 19.4 days timeout and 300 ms/200 ms wait; manual 2.1 s/125 ns assumes 8 MHz.
fix: Make wait/timeout clock-selectable; document single-step/run modes; add clock divider or external clock input.

title: 490 IC BOM excludes 18 unexpanded blocks and has missing footprints/decoupling
evidence: BOM 861 physical refs, 490 ICs, 18 block symbols, 96 10k resistors with U refs and no footprint, engines lack decoupling.
fix: Expand blocks and clean BOM before fabrication; count physical packages only.

title: CONV2 input address uses HWC while Pool1 and spec use CHW
evidence: build_conv2.py note/formula (oy+ky)*96+(ox+kx)*8+ic; build_pool.py OUT_ADDR c*144+y*12+x; spec 2.1 CHW; layout harness 7198/7200 mismatches; old SY96 chain also had +481 offset.
fix: IN_ADDR = ic*144+(oy+ky)*12+(ox+kx); update golden/SPICE/notes; regenerate S08.

title: 74HC138 state-decoder outputs CAPTURE_N/DONE_ST_N/HOLD_N/RELEASE_N/WAIT_N have no loads
evidence: S02 netlist: outputs only carry local labels; nCE/nOE/nWE/ACK/DONE are generated by U3/U5, not these decoder outputs.
fix: Remove unused outputs or add test points; cosmetic ERC cleanup.

title: 74HC138 enable polarity: original ~E1=MEM_nCE is correct (false alarm)
evidence: Original decoder138 call used e0=GND, e1=MEM_nCE, e2=+5V. 74HC138 ~E1 is active-low, so the decoder was enabled during a transaction. The bus patch moved MEM_nCE to ~E0, which is functionally equivalent.
fix: No functional fix required; the E0/E1 move is a readability refactor.
